dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anywhere suitable for adventurers around here?

dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: Haha, oh man, you're late by about twenty years.

dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: Back in the day, the Mare Jivari was THE location to spelunk and explore. It drew adventure teams from all over Teyvat. Unfortunately, it's gone now.

dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: If you'd been around back then, you'd have made loads of like-minded friends, and there'd be a million places to visit.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did the adventure teams find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: Well... Nobody could crack the code of why the Mare Jivari disappeared, but I heard a few were able to enter some secret area that they thought was it.

dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: Apparently, there was more than one strange little pocket like this. People came to call them the "Mare Enthymema." They say it's like the Mare Jivari casting a shadow of itself into our world.

dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: But in the last few years, there haven't even been any sightings of the Mare Enthymema...
